news.analysis: Lock continues to win as a starter for the Seahawks. His two touchdowns came on improvised deep passes to Cooper Kupp and Jaxon Smith-Njigba. The Seahawks now head into their bye week with the quarterback situation unclear heading into Week 12.
news.contents: Drew Lock completed 14-of-17 passes for 240 yards with two touchdowns in the Seahawks 21-13 win over the Raiders.
news.title: Drew Lock tosses two touchdowns Sunday

news.analysis: Jeanty was once again shut down on the ground. The majority of his yardage on the day came on a catch and run for 38 yards. He remains a borderline RB2 play for fantasy managers right now.
news.contents: Ashton Jeanty ran for 18 yards on nine carries in the Raiders 21-13 loss against the Seahawks. He also caught 4-of-4 targets for 46 yards receiving.
news.title: Ashton Jeanty totals 64 yards from scrimmage Sunday

news.contents: Las Vegas Raiders running back Ashton Jeanty continued his lackluster performance on the ground during Sunday's game against the Seattle Seahawks. Jeanty carried the ball nine times for 18 yards as he continues to find no room to run. This marks the sixth straight game that Jeanty has finished with fewer than 30 rushing yards. news.title: Ashton Jeanty Remains Insufficient in Defeat

news.analysis: Mason has struggled to find room out of the Minnesota backfield to this point, totaling less than 60 offensive yards in four of his five games. The running back remains part of an underperforming Minnesota backfield alongside Aaron Jones Sr. entering a Week 11 matchup against the San Francisco 49ers.
news.contents: Jordan Mason carried the ball 16 times for 59 yards while failing to catch his only target in the Vikings' 30-10 Week 10 win over the Packers.
news.title: Jordan Mason leads backfield in Week 10 win over Packers

news.analysis: Watson was held in check by a stout Minnesota defense, being held to less than 50 receiving yards for the first time in six games. The wideout will look to return to his impactful form for fantasy managers after the team's Week 11 bye.
news.contents: Christian Watson caught three of his five targets for 37 yards in the Packers' 30-10 Week 10 loss to the Vikings.
news.title: Christian Watson bottled up in Week 10 loss

Tyson and the Saints will take on the Bears in Week 11.

The 27-year-old has not found the end zone in the last two games and has seen his target share dip during that time. Kincaid will look to turn in a better performance in Week 11 against the Jets.
news.contents: Dalton Kincaid caught 2-of-3 passes for 58 yards in a 31-12 win over the Jets.

news.contents: Bills tight end Dalton Kincaid has a great chance to go off against the New York Jets in Week 10. Kincaid recorded a modest performance against the Minnesota Vikings a week ago, finishing with just three receptions for 28 yards. But this week, he will take on a New York Jets secondary that gave up four receptions for 72 yards and a touchdown to Kansas City Chiefs tight end Travis Kelce a week ago. news.analysis: Aubrey continues a scorching stretch of late, finishing with eight or more points in each of his last four games. The kicker remains one of the more impactful options ahead of a favorable Week 11 contest against the Tennessee Titans.
news.contents: Brandon Aubrey converted both of his field goal attempts as well as 2-of-3 extra point attempts to finish with eight points in the Cowboys' 46-40 loss to the 49ers in Week 10.
news.title: Brandon Aubrey misses extra point in Week 10

news.contents: Dallas Cowboys kicker Brandon Aubrey converted from 45 and 28 yards at Indianapolis and missed wide left from 50. Dallas has scored at least 27 points in three straight games, and Aubrey has converted three extra points in each. He also went three-for-four on field goals against Arizona, giving him seven field-goal attempts over the past two weeks. news.contents: Dre Greenlaw (knee) is active for Week 10 for the San Francisco 49ers against the Dallas Cowboys.

In his absence, rookie Emmett Johnson topped 100 rushing yards for the first time in his career, adding an additional 70 yards and two touchdowns through the air, and it's possible he's earned an expanded role even upon Walker's return. news.analysis: Lloyd has been dismal out of the Green Bay backfield to this point, rushing for less than 40 yards in each of his nine games. The running back remains one of many risky backfield options, with Green Bay's next contest in Week 12 against the Los Angeles Rams after a bye in Week 11.
news.contents: MarShawn Lloyd rushed four times for 13 yards while also catching all three of his targets for 26 yards in the Packers' 30-10 loss to the Vikings in Week 10.

news.analysis: TeSlaa hauled in a 12-yard touchdown in the second quarter, his first TD of the season. The veteran wideout has been sparingly used as Detroit's No. 3 receiver this season, catching 13 passes for 225 yards in nine games. He will now prepare to face the Buccaneers in Week 11.
